method: Each fixture/method in a fresh worker;2 warmups and11 measured repetitions; exact roundtrip verified every time; actual same authenticated envelope verified. Native-codec baselines use their APIs; RB includes its bounded decode adapter. Peak RSS includes interpreter and loaded libraries. Not a universal compression/AI speed claim.
dictionary_accounting: No dictionary used by any method. Protocol decoder installation costs excluded equally. Public language opcode dictionary is not a compression dictionary.
packet_scope: BENCH-AEAD-1 is a common benchmark envelope, not the production RBW1 protocol. Fixed-width numeric codec IDs avoid name-length bias. Full-byte count includes JSON, nonce, tag and signature.
limitations: Synthetic disclosed corpus; no representative production-traffic claim
RB selects maintained codecs or an exact structure transform; fallback reuse is not an independent new entropy coder
Peak RSS is process high-water mark, not isolated codec buffer allocation
No transmitted private keys or real owner vault use
